identifier.value: Tammouk (Ownership Financing)

product.name: Tammouk (Ownership Financing)
product.description: Provides financing for individuals and companies to own residential, administrative, commercial, service, or medical units with loans up to 300 million EGP and repayment terms up to 10 years.

identifier.value: Wafra (Liquidity Financing)

product.name: Wafra (Liquidity Financing)
product.description: Offers liquidity financing up to 300 million EGP on any owned residential, administrative, commercial, service, or medical unit with repayment terms up to 10 years.

identifier.value: Mahafiz (Portfolio Financing for Developers)

product.name: Mahafiz (Portfolio Financing for Developers)
product.description: Enables real estate developers to obtain liquidity by transferring rights of their real estate portfolios to Al Taamir for financing purposes.

identifier.value: Central Bank Initiative Financing

product.name: Central Bank Initiative Financing
product.description: Supports low- and middle-income individuals through financing programs aligned with the Central Bank of Egypt's housing finance initiatives.

identifier.value: Real Estate Appraisal Service

product.name: Real Estate Appraisal Service
product.description: Provides property valuation services to determine the fair market value of real estate units during financing application processes.

identifier.value: I-Score Credit Report Analysis

product.name: I-Score Credit Report Analysis
product.description: Evaluates clients' credit reports (I-Score) to assess creditworthiness during mortgage financing applications.
